governance.scope: Existing quality and native macOS coverage plus originating-account independent review and Chaos Scheduler App-owned squash delivery. Existing dependency maintenance and private binary release boundaries remain separately governed. No product, installed runtime or release change.
governance.review_trust: Owner-enrolled operational local capture. Work and personal origins are distinct; a review receipt cannot establish origin. No provider-signature or same-principal anti-forgery claim.
governance.activation: The PRE-MIGRATION ordinary App excludes automation paths, so the initial PR installing this successor requires exact owner-controlled administrative admission after review and real CI. Once admitted and qualified, this successor accepts owner-created PRs, including automation source changes, only with substantive independent originating-account review and exact CI. No recurring human technical-review gate is added. Binary signing, publication and product release remain separately authorized. New writer stays OFF until current-main CI, account admission, App readiness and owner-visible controls are verified; agents do not merge or manipulate PR auto-merge.
governance.reference: KleinPerkins/kp-pr-bot-canary 75148194a0e8b0f63674a3e441639cc633ca12b8, with machine-monitor receipt enrollment and canonical Git-diff corrections. Repository identity, case-sensitive Scripts/Tests paths and actual four CI jobs are adapted here.
governance.coordination: The authoring agent automatically captures review, creates the PR/origin witness, and separately publishes the unedited review receipt with the g1-review-receipt:v1 marker. The creation adapter is deliberately origin-only. No human technical-review or receipt-publication step is required.
governance.administrative_visibility: The delivery coordinator must inspect exact owner-visible bypass actors before activation. App-scoped omission remains explicitly unknown; App qualification does not attest hidden actors. Visible unexpected actors reject, and Integration/App bypass is unauthorized. This accepted administrative boundary is operational trust, not protection against a privileged owner changing controls after qualification.
governance.ambiguous_creation: An ambiguous create/origin-publication response deliberately blocks automatic delivery. The agent preserves the journal and diagnoses actual branch/nonce/PR/comment state read-only. No blind retry, duplicate PR or inferred account witness is authorized; automatic coordination does not require unconditional recovery from unknown origin.
